proposition.claim:
Smooth cutoff rises from 0 on [0,1/2] to 1 on [1,infinity), with 0<=zeta'<=4 and |zeta''|<=16; eta has reversed endpoints and the same absolute derivative bounds.

v(t)=zeta'(1/2+t) is C1 on [0,1/2]. v vanishes at both endpoints by smooth matching. Integral v is exactly1 by the prescribed total increment. |v'|<=16.
